stp.title: Store details
stp.sub: The shop's legal numbers. The shop prints each one only when it is filled in; nothing made up ever shows.

legal.d: Printed in the footer on one line with the copyright, on every invoice and on the help page. Leave a box empty until you have the number: the shop then leaves that line out.
legal.dbidHelp: From the e-CAB / Ministry of Commerce registration.
legal.binHelp: Printed on invoices when you are VAT registered.

err.STALE: Someone else changed this card; it shows their values now.
err.PLACEHOLDER: Type the real number, not a stand-in like [number], TBD or xxx ({fields}). Leave the box empty until you have it.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission to change this.
err.unauthorized: Your sign-in has ended — please sign in again.
err.other: That did not save. Please try again.

stp.readOnly: You can see these details; changing them needs the settings permission.
